title: B7 face wired (GATED): formal/RhAttack/B7Far.lean consumes the MFar pins and machine-checks five gates - decomposition (nl = M - D exact), share windows (near-log share |nl|/|M| in [5%,7%]/[6e-4,7e-4]/[7e-5,8e-5] at the three far pins), share decay (>=10x per decade), NOT-A-LINE-IN-LN-T (second drop ratio in [7,9], measured 8.0804, vs the ln-t line 0.477121 and the t*ln-t family 2.2875), and T^2 STEP CONSISTENCY (the drop ratio within 1e-3 absolute of the pure t^2 step ratio (t30^2-t10^2)/(t10^2-t9^2) = 8.0808081 at the EXACT pinned heights, measured gap 4.57e-4, nearest competing family 0.79 away): the residual shape is the t^2 / kernel -t^2/g^2 family, identified at the drop-ratio level in norm_num. b7OpenFace declares the open MECHANISM (a positive far-side excess on the s29 g-window [2e8,1e11] whose generated drift hits the pinned D) in the S4Blind s4OpenFace pattern - measured, not proven. The endpoint is untouched (far region vacuous in the body from [Z78]; the B7 face is a measured constraint, not one of the four named residuals). 97 cards; full tree green (17450 jobs)
body: FORMAL MILESTONE (no RH claim): the B7 far-side structure (the census drift) is now a module in the Lean tree.  MODULE:  formal/RhAttack/B7Far.lean (namespace B7F;  imports Mathlib + RhAttack.MFar;  build green;  the full tree re-verified at 17450 jobs, 0 errors).  CONTENT:  (1) the near-log PART nl = M - D pinned from the s33b record by EXACT arithmetic on the pins (nl9 = -609469941, nl10 = -667658569.9, nl30 = -695421601.6):  the 50-digit cross-check A ln t + B vs M - D lives in the Python record (diffs +1.06 / +0.048 / -0.51 units on the three rows = the f64 pipeline noise on the s33b D values) and the Real log never enters a Lean gate.  (2) FIVE GATED gates, all norm_num on the pinned rationals:  decompositionGates (nl = M - D exactly on each pin, so the nl values are the s33b near-log part BY CONSTRUCTION, not a re-fit);  shareWindows (the near-log share |nl|/|M| in [5%, 7%] at 1e9G, [0.06%, 0.07%] at 1e10G, [0.007%, 0.008%] at 3e10G - measured 5.87% / 0.0683% / 0.0079% - windows cross-multiplied to stay in the positive rationals);  shareDecay (the share shrinks by >= 10x from 1e9G to 1e10G and >= 5x from 1e10G to 3e10G:  the t^2 term is what the far M channel IS);  notLineInLnT (the M drops are positive and the second drop ratio drop30/drop10 = 7820264275968/967812386816 = 8.0804 sits in [7, 9], while a line in ln t through the first two far pins would give ln(t30/t10)/ln(t10/t9) = 0.47712125472 and the t ln t family would give 2.28748 - both documented 50-dp facts on the pinned heights:  a factor ~16.9 / a gap 0.79 from the window, so the s33 'degeneracy survives' reading is closed at the data level);  t2stepConsistency (NEW THIS ENTRY:  the cross-multiplied gap |drop30 (t10^2 - t9^2) - drop10 (t30^2 - t10^2)| against drop10 (t10^2 - t9^2) satisfies 1000 * gap <= drop10 (t10^2 - t9^2) - i.e. the measured drop ratio 8.0803515 is within 1e-3 ABSOLUTE of the PURE t^2 step ratio (t30^2 - t10^2)/(t10^2 - t9^2) = 8.0808081 (exact rational at the pinned f64 heights; the pinned ratio itself sits 1.4e-15 from the ideal 800/99 of the 3x/10x steps) with measured gap 4.566e-4 (norm_num margin 2.2x), while every competing measured family is >= 0.79 away (790x the window):  the residual shape is IDENTIFIED as the t^2 family (the kernel -t^2/g^2 tail of the s25 candidate list) at the drop-ratio level, to 4.6e-4 absolute, machine-checked.  (3) b7OpenFace (the S4Blind s4OpenFace PATTERN - a Prop declaration, not a proof):  for ANY mechanism map gen (excess-on-scale to generated drift), there EXISTS a positive far-side count excess E, supported on the measured s29 g-window [2e8, 1e11] in g = t/G units, whose generated drift hits the three pinned D values:  the open MECHANISM mathematics, named, with the five gates as its measured shadow.  HONESTY SPLIT:  LEAN-PROVEN the five gates (norm_num on the pins);  DECLARED the face (measured, not proven);  PINNED the nl values from the s33b record.  ENDPOINT RELATION:  RHEnd.rh_program78 is UNAFFECTED - the far region is VACUOUS in the body from [Z78] (Z78P12.offPairFarEmpty), so the B7 face is a MEASURED CONSTRAINT that any RH proof must reproduce (the PATHWAY section 3 list), NOT one of the four named endpoint residuals (hs1 / hs3 / hWin / hS2low).  CARDS:  97 cards / 749 body lines (new card formal/cards/B7Far.md;  the MFar card's USES now names B7Far as consumer);  _MAP.md carries the B7Far block (five gates + the face + the endpoint-relation note).  Next consumer candidates:  the walk (B1) and the law-territory clause (B5);  the remaining named endpoint faces (hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low, S4Blind.s4OpenFace) are untouched by this entry.
